record.title: Nonnegativity of the coefficients of the complete cd-index of a Bruhat interval
record.statement: For every Bruhat interval $[u,v]$ in a Coxeter system $(W,S)$, all coefficients of its complete cd-index $\widetilde{\Psi}_{u,v}$ are nonnegative; equivalently, in $\widetilde{\Psi}_{u,v}=\sum_w [w]_{u,v}w$, one has $[w]_{u,v}\ge 0$ for every cd-word $w$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/04](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1455), page 16. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uniqueness of entire functions from shared differential-polynomial values
record.statement: Let $f$ and $g$ be non-constant entire functions, let $a,b\in\mathbb{C}\setminus\{0\}$, and let $n,k$ be positive integers with $n\ge 11$ and $n\ge k+2$. Define $P[f]=f^n+a f^{(k)}$ and $P[g]=g^n+a g^{(k)}$. If $P[f]$ and $P[g]$ share the value $b$ counting multiplicities, must $f\equiv g$? The report emphasizes that this was unknown even for $k=1$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/09](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1460), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Mues' deficiency-sum conjecture for derivatives of meromorphic functions
record.statement: Every transcendental meromorphic function $f$ satisfies, for every positive integer $n$, $$\sum_{a\in\mathbb{C}}\delta\bigl(a,f^{(n)}\bigr)\le 1.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/09](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1460), page 27. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Density of bounded holomorphic functions
record.statement: Let $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be a domain. Under which conditions is $H^\infty(\Omega)$ locally uniformly dense in $H(\Omega)$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/09](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1460), page 29. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Eremenko’s conjecture: connected components of the escaping set
record.statement: For every entire function $f$, every connected component of the escaping set $I(f)$ is unbounded.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/09](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1460), page 44. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Unbounded Fatou components for entire functions of small growth
record.statement: Is it true that, for every transcendental entire function $f$ of order at most $1/2$ and minimal type, the Fatou set $F(f)$ has no unbounded component?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/09](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1460), page 50. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Julia sets of polynomial semigroups when one element has the semigroup Julia set
record.statement:
Let $G$ be a polynomial semigroup such that $J_h=J(G)$ for some $h
gin G$, where $J(G)$ is not a line segment. Then $J_f=J_g$ for all $f,g\in G$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/09](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1460), page 53. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Non-algebraic patchworked pseudoholomorphic curves in \(\Sigma_2\)
record.statement: For every integer \(d\ge 3\), there exists a smooth real pseudoholomorphic patchworked curve of bidegree \((d,0)\) in \(\Sigma_2\) that is not \(\mathcal L\)-isotopic to any real algebraic curve in \(\Sigma_2\) of the same bidegree.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1465), page 8. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: BMV conjecture for exponents $m\le 9$
record.statement: Whenever $A,B\in\operatorname{Sym}(\mathbb{C}^{s\times s})$ are positive semidefinite, the polynomial $\operatorname{tr}((A+tB)^m)\in\mathbb{R}[t]$ has nonnegative coefficients for every $m\le 9$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1465), page 29. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Hadwiger’s conjecture for quasi-line graphs
record.statement: Every finite quasi-line graph $G$ with chromatic number $\cchi(G)$ has a clique minor of size $\cchi(G)$. Here, a quasi-line graph is a graph in which, for every vertex $v$, the neighborhood of $v$ can be expressed as the union of two cliques.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1532), page 3. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Bonato–Janssen uniqueness claim for infinite locally random graphs
record.statement: For finite graphs $G$ and $H$, let $\uparrow G$ and $\uparrow H$ denote the limit graphs obtained by iterating the pure-extension construction, in which for every vertex $x$ and every finite set $X\subseteq N[x]$ a new vertex with neighborhood $X$ is added. Bonato and Janssen claimed that $\uparrow G\cong\uparrow H$ for every pair of finite graphs $G,H$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1532), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: 3-colorability of triangle-free graphs on a fixed surface
record.statement: For every surface $\Sigma$ there exists a polynomial-time algorithm that, given an input triangle-free graph $G$ embedded in $\Sigma$, correctly determines whether $G$ is $3$-colorable.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1532), page 44. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Bisimplicial vertices in even-hole-free graphs
record.statement: Every finite simple even-hole-free graph contains a bisimplicial vertex, where an even-hole-free graph has no induced cycle of even length at least four, and a vertex is bisimplicial if its set of neighbors induces a graph that is the union of two cliques.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1532), page 49. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Existence of many internally disjoint non-separating paths
record.statement: Does there exist a function $f_1(k)$ such that, for every $f_1(k)$-connected graph $G$ and every pair $s$ and $t$ of vertices in $G$, there exist $k$ internally disjoint non-separating paths $P_1,\ldots,P_k$ whose endpoints are $s$ and $t$? Here, non-separating means that $G-V(P_i)$ is connected.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1532), page 51. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Conjecture 2: a path disjoint from a highly connected subgraph
record.statement: There exists a function $f_3(k)$ such that for every $f_3(k)$-connected graph $G$ and every three vertices $s$, $t$, and $x$ in $G$, there exists an $s$-$t$ path $P$ and a $k$-connected subgraph $H$ with $x\in V(H)$ such that $V(H)\cap V(P)=\varnothing$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1532), page 52. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Kriesell’s removable-path conjecture
record.statement: There exists a function $f_2(k)$ such that, for every $f_2(k)$-connected graph $G$ and every pair of vertices $u$ and $v$ of $G$, there exists a path $P$ such that $G-E(P)$ is $k$-connected.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/16](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1532), page 53. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finiteness conjecture for fusion categories of fixed rank
record.statement: For every fixed positive integer $r$, there are only finitely many fusion categories of rank $r$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/17](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1533), page 23. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Nonexistence of asymptotically minimal Riesz-energy sequences on the circle
record.statement: For every $s>1$, there exists no sequence $b_n_{n=1}^{\infty}\subset S^1$ such that the sequence of configurations $b_n_{n=1}^N_{N=1}^{\infty}$ is AEM$(S^1;s)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1535), page 31. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Falconer distance set conjecture at the critical dimension threshold
record.statement: It is believed that, for every integer $n\ge 2$ and every Borel set $A\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, $$\dim A>\frac n2\quad\Longrightarrow\quad L^1(D(A))>0,$$ where $D(A)=\{|x-y|:x,y\in A\}$ and $L^1$ denotes one-dimensional Lebesgue measure.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1535), page 34. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Kurek–Ruciński conjecture on the on-line size Ramsey number
record.statement: **Conjecture 1.** For all positive integers $c$ and $t$, $$\lim_{t\to\infty}\frac{\operatorname{size\text{-}oRam}^{2}_{c}(t)}{\operatorname{size\text{-}Ram}^{2}_{c}(t)}=0.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1536), page 15. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Beck’s conjecture for positional games
record.statement: For an arbitrary hypergraph $(V,F)$: if Maker wins the corresponding Maker–Breaker game as the second player, then Picker wins the corresponding Picker–Chooser game; and if Breaker wins the corresponding Maker–Breaker game as the second player, then Picker wins the corresponding Chooser–Picker game.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1536), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Generalization of the online edge-coloring threshold to arbitrarily many colors
record.statement: The generalization of Theorem 2.1 to an arbitrary number of colors $r\ge 2$ remains a challenging open problem.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1536), page 29. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Avoider’s winning strategy in the \(1:n/10\) Hamiltonicity game
record.statement: Prove that Avoider has a winning strategy in the \(1:n/10\) Hamiltonicity game.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/20](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1536), page 37. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Existence of a Diophantine quintuple
record.statement: Does there exist a set $S$ of five positive distinct integers such that, for every pair of distinct elements $x,y\in S$, the number $xy+1$ is a perfect square?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1537), page 3. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Schinzel’s reduced-length inequality
record.statement:
Is the inequality
$$
l\bigl((x^2+tx+1)P(x)\bigr)\ge 2M(P)
$$
true for all $t\in[-2,2]$ and all $P\in\mathbb{R}[x]$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1537), page 22. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Bounded Height Conjecture for Subvarieties of a Multiplicative Torus
record.statement: Let $X\subset \mathbb{G}_m^n$ be an irreducible closed subvariety defined over $\mathbb{Q}$. The set $X^{\mathrm{oa}}(\mathbb{Q})\cap (\mathbb{G}_m^n)^{[\dim X]}$ has uniformly bounded absolute Weil height.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1537), page 27. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uniqueness of the non-trivial diagonal Nagell–Ljunggren solution
record.statement:
For integers $x,y$, an odd prime $p$, and $e\in\{0,1\}$ satisfying
\[
\frac{x^p-1}{x-1}=p^e y^p,
\]
the report conjectures that the displayed solution
\[
\frac{18^3-1}{18-1}=7^3
\]
is the only non-trivial solution.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1537), page 34. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: One-dimensional Duffin–Schaeffer conjecture
record.statement:
For every function \(\psi:[0,\infty)\to[0,\infty)\), let
\[
S_1(\psi)=\left\{x\in[0,1]: |qx-p|<\psi(q)\text{ for infinitely many }(q,p)\in\mathbb N\times\mathbb Z\text{ with }\gcd(q,p)=1\right\}.
\]
If
\[
\sum_{q=1}^{\infty}\frac{\varphi(q)\,\psi(q)}{q}=\infty,
\]
then \(|S_1(\psi)|=1\), where \(|\cdot|\) denotes Lebesgue measure.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1537), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Euler’s question on four positive integers with the D(-1) property
record.statement: Does there exist a set $D\subseteq\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$ consisting of four positive integers such that, for all distinct $x,y\in D$, the number $xy+x+y$ is a perfect square?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1537), page 51. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Four-integer Diophantus–Euler square-product-plus-sum problem
record.statement: Conjecture: There is no set $D\subseteq\mathbb Z$ with exactly four elements such that, for every pair of distinct elements $x,y\in D$, the integer $xy+x+y$ is a perfect square.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1537), page 52. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Diophantine quintuple conjecture
record.statement: A Diophantine $m$-tuple is a set of $m$ positive integers such that $a_i a_j+1$ is a perfect square for every pair of distinct elements $a_i,a_j$. The conjecture is that no Diophantine quintuple exists; equivalently, there is no set of five positive integers with this property.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1537), page 53. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Mahler–Mendès France binary-sequence problem
record.statement:
For every non-eventually periodic binary sequence $(a_n)_{n\ge 0}$, prove that at least one of the two real numbers
\[
\alpha=\sum_{n\ge 0}\frac{a_n}{2^n},\qquad \beta=\sum_{n\ge 0}\frac{a_n}{3^n}
\]
is transcendental.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1537), page 60. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Determination of Lusztig-conjecture scalars for $G^{F^2}$
record.statement:
Let $G$ be a classical group with connected center, defined over a finite field $
F_q$ of characteristic $p$ with Frobenius map $F$, and assume that $DG\neq\operatorname{Spin}_N$. In Lusztig’s conjecture, with $\chi_{A_x,\phi_x}=\zeta_xR_x$ for the corresponding $F$-stable character sheaf $A_x$ and almost character $R_x$, the scalars $\zeta_x$ can be determined for $G^{F^2}$ for every $p$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/22](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1538), page 19. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Proper regular solutions of finite split embedding problems over a Henselian quotient field
record.statement: Let $R$ be a domain which is Henselian with respect to some non-trivial ideal $\a$, and let $K=\operatorname{Quot}(R)$ be its field of fractions. Then $K$ is a large field. In particular, every finite split embedding problem for $G_K$ has $|K|$ different proper regular solutions.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1542), page 5. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Weak torsion conjecture for Jacobians of cyclic covers
record.statement: For any number field $k$, any integer $r\ge 2$, and primes $p,q$ with $p\nmid 2r$, there exists a constant $n_k(p,q,r)\ge 1$ such that, for every $f:Y\to\mathbb{P}^1_k$ in $\mathcal{H}_{\mathbb{Z}/p,2r}(k)$, there is no embedding $\mu_{q^n}\hookrightarrow J_Y|_k$ for $n\ge n_k(p,q,r)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/26](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1542), page 27. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Strong zero-one law for multidimensional diffusions in random environment
record.statement:
For the stationary, bounded, Lipschitz-continuous, uniformly elliptic, finite-range-dependent diffusion in random environment described on the source pages, does the strong zero-one law
\[
P_0(A_\ell)\in\{0,1\}
\]
hold for every unit vector \(\ell\in\mathbb{R}^d\) when \(d\ge 3\), where \(A_\ell\) is the event that the diffusion escapes to infinity in direction \(\ell\)?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1543), page 12. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Coincidence of quenched and annealed Lyapunov exponents
record.statement:
Suppose $d \ge 4$ and $h>0$. Then there exists $\beta_0>0$ such that $m^{\mathrm{qu}}(h,\beta)=m^{\mathrm{an}}(h,\beta)$ for all $\beta\le\beta_0$. Moreover, when $V_x$ is bounded, there exists $K<\infty$ such that
$$
\mathbb{E}\left|\log Z_{V,h,\beta}(N)-\log \mathbb{E}Z_{V,h,\beta}(N)\right|\le K\left(1+\beta\sqrt{N}\right)
$$
for all $N\in\mathbb{N}$ and $\beta\le\beta_0$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1543), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Aging probability for the p-spin trap-model dynamics
record.statement: Let $A_N^{\varepsilon}(t,s)=\{R_N(\sigma_N(te^{\gamma N}),\sigma_N((t+s)e^{\gamma N}))\ge 1-\varepsilon\}$. Under the hypothesis of Theorem 1, for every $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ and $t,s>0$, $$\lim_{N\to\infty}\mathbb{P}[A_N^{\varepsilon}(t,s)]=\frac{\sin(\alpha\pi)}{\pi}\int_{0}^{t/(t+s)}u^{\alpha-1}(1-u)^{-\alpha}\,du.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/28](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1544), page 10. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Translation invariance of the two-dimensional hard-sphere Gibbs model
record.statement:
Let $r>0$, let $|\cdot|$ be any norm on $\mathbb{R}^{2}$, and define the pure hard-core potential
\[
U_{\mathrm{hc}}(x_1,x_2):=
\begin{cases}
\infty,& |x_1-x_2|\le r,\\
0,& |x_1-x_2|>r,
\end{cases}
\qquad x_1,x_2\in\mathbb{R}^{2}.
\]
Then, for every activity $z>0$, all equilibrium states corresponding to $U_{\mathrm{hc}}$ and $z$ are translation-invariant.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/28](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1544), page 51. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Functional majorants for distributed optimal control problems with control constraints
record.statement:
For any control $u\in K$ and state $y\in H^1_0(\Omega)$, with arbitrary $w\in H^1_0(\Omega)$, $\tau\in H_{\mathrm{div}}(\Omega,\mathbb{R}^n)$, and $\beta>0$, the report asserts

$$J^{\ominus}(y;w)\le J(y^*,u^*)\le J(y^{u+f},u)\le J^{\oplus}(y,u;\beta;\tau).$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/29](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1585), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Existence of a nice character satisfying Assumption A(F,p)
record.statement: For every totally real number field $F$ and every prime number $p\ge 3$, Assumption $A(F,p)$ holds: there exists a finite-order character $\chi:G_F\to\mathfrak{o}_{\mathfrak p}^{\times}$ that is nice, meaning that (i) $\chi$ is totally odd and has order prime to $p$; (ii) $\chi$ is unramified at every $v\mid p$ and $\chi(\operatorname{Fr}_v)\ne 1$; and (iii) $H_f^1(F,\overline{\chi}^{\,\pm1})=0$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/30](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1586), page 12. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Existence of multi-output Boolean functions with maximal algebraic immunity
record.statement:
For all integers $1 \le m \le n$, there exists a function $f:\{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}^m$ whose algebraic immunity is $d^*(n,m)$, where $d^*(n,m)$ is the least integer $d$ such that
\[
\sum_{i=0}^{d} \binom{n+m}{i} > 2^n.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/31](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1587), page 46. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Conjectural sharp threshold in Theorem 1
record.statement: The constant $n_0$ in Theorem 1 is at least $12$, and the authors conjecture that equality holds.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/32](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1588), page 15. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Generalised Riemann Hypothesis for Hecke L-functions
record.statement: For every prime number $q$ and every $f\in H^*_{\kappa}(q)$, all zeros of the completed Hecke $L$-function $\Lambda(f,s)$ lie on the critical line $\{s\in\mathbb{C}:\Re s=1/2\}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1590), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Artin’s primitive root conjecture for 2
record.statement:
Let $S$ be the set of primes $p$ such that $2$ is a primitive root modulo $p$. Artin conjectured that $S$ has density
$$
C=\prod_q\left(1-\frac{1}{q(q-1)}\right)=0.3739\ldots,
$$
where the product is over all primes $q$; equivalently, $N(x,S)\sim C\,\pi(x)$ as $x\to\infty$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1590), page 34. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Mordell–Weil rank 18 for elliptic K3 surfaces over \(\mathbb{Q}(T)\)
record.statement: Can an elliptic K3 surface have Mordell–Weil rank \(18\) over \(\mathbb{Q}(T)\)?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1590), page 42. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rotation-invariance question for the spherical random field
record.statement: For the random field $(T_\xi)_{\xi\in S^2}$ describing the CMB, is $\xi\mapsto T_\xi$ rotation-invariant in the sense that, for every $\rho\in O(3)$ and every $\xi,\eta\in S^2$, $\mathbb E(T_\xi,T_\eta)=\mathbb E(T_{\rho(\xi)},T_{\rho(\eta)})$, with $\mathbb E T_\xi=c$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/36](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1592), page 50. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Thompson’s conjecture on products of conjugacy classes
record.statement: Every finite simple group $G$ has a conjugacy class $C$ such that $C^2=G$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1593), page 8. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: The Ore conjecture
record.statement: Every element of every finite non-abelian simple group is a commutator.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1593), page 27. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Hadamard conjecture for Hadamard simplices
record.statement: For every integer dimension $d>1$ such that $d+1$ is divisible by $4$, there exists a Hadamard simplex in $[-1,1]^d$, i.e. a regular simplex whose $d+1$ vertices are vertices of the cube.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2007/39](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1595), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
